newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HIBS' POINT EARNS EARLY SEASON LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HIBS' POINT EARNS EARLY SEASON LEAD.

text.p: Hibernian came from behind to draw 1-1 at Dundee United on Sunday and move to the top of the early season Scottish premier division standings.
Robbie Winters put United ahead two minutes before half time but Hibs, who beat Celtic in their opening fixture last week, were always in contention
Things turned in their favour in the 67th minute when United's Maurice Malpas was sent off for a second bookable offence and it took the Edinburgh side just 10 minutes to cash in.
United goalkeeper Sieb Dijkstra was penalised under the new law limited the time the ball can be held. Brian Grant and Chick Charnley worked the free kick back to Paul Tosh who fired home.
The draw gives Hibs four points from two games and puts them above St. Johnstone by virtue of having scored more goals.
